expect: slug `blumen` equals the `shopCategory` path segment of `de`
why: spec 008 AC-2: a listing slug may not equal a `PATH_SEGMENT_KEYS` value in its locale. The mixed-flowers category renamed `Blumen` folds to `blumen`, which is the German shop segment, so `/de/blumen` would mean both the segment and a category hub (§2 'Segment collision is impossible by test').
